Utility

A batch of districts run as one utility: its year day by day, how the shared workforce moved between districts, every district's saved run and the events on the shared upstream networks. Everything shown was computed when the batch ran.

Run a utility batch and open it here

Run the districts of a utility, sharing one workforce and connected upstream networks:

utilsim batch-run --homes 50000 --chunk-size 2000 --staffing shared --float-share 0.3 --network connected --store out/store

Then serve the store beside the Studio and open the batch folder:

UTILSIM_RUN_STORE=out/store node web/serve.mjs
http://localhost:5175/utility.html?batch=/batches/<jobKey>/

A paused batch shows the districts that are finished. Independent batches (--staffing independent-districts) have no staff allocation; unconnected ones have no upstream events.
